items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: Schocker wanted me to go to Japan with him

ctx.x: Of course these places like Preservation Hall, they pack in big crowds. They, uh, I understand that. Or is that a different kind of, do you think that's a different kind of an audience, I guess, than the audience you've got?

I don't know too much about them, Tom, but I do believe that some of the regular, some of the die-hard Vixeland fans do frequent those places. But then too, I think that just a lot of visitors drop in. And whether, what degree, what varying degrees they like music, whether it's just curiosity many times. But since Dixieland and some of these musicians have gotten so much international publicity and, uh, not too much lately perhaps, but about eight, ten years, twelve years ago, you know, they were going to Japan…
